recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的纖維化區域內可見淡色、呈扇形或放射狀排列的針狀結晶聚集，周圍有梭形細胞與組織球反應包圍；在骨髓切片中看到這種結晶加異物反應，應想到草酸鹽沉積（hyperoxalosis）。
features: Pale, refractile, needle-shaped crystals arranged in fan-like/radiating aggregates within a peritrabecular fibrous nodule
Crystal aggregates surrounded by spindle cells and histiocytes consistent with a foreign-body-type reaction
Adjacent broad lamellar bone trabecula with irregular, scalloped surfaces suggesting active remodeling
Separate amorphous basophilic deposit in the upper right field, likely additional crystal/mineral material
Residual cellular marrow with scattered adipocytes at the periphery of the core
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow trephine shows a broad bony trabecula with irregular, scalloped margins. Adjacent to the trabecula there is a fibrous nodule containing aggregates of pale, needle-shaped crystals in radiating sheaves, surrounded by spindle cells and histiocytes in keeping with a foreign-body reaction. Peritrabecular fibrosis is present, and an additional amorphous basophilic deposit is seen in the upper right field; the remaining marrow is cellular with scattered fat. Polarized-light examination is not available in this image. Findings are consistent with marrow and bone involvement by oxalate crystal deposition (hyperoxalosis).

ddx.vs: Urate deposits are usually amorphous, feathery material dissolved out of formalin-fixed tissue with a palisading histiocytic rim and are negatively birefringent needles, whereas calcium oxalate crystals persist in routine sections as pale yellow rhomboid/rosette crystals that are strongly birefringent.
Shows tunneling resorption and peritrabecular fibrosis similar to this case but lacks crystal aggregates with a foreign-body giant cell reaction.
Histiocytes contain intracytoplasmic eosinophilic rod-like immunoglobulin crystals associated with a plasma cell neoplasm rather than extracellular radiating crystal sheaves in fibrous stroma.

ddx.dx: Foreign-material granuloma (e.g., prior biopsy site debris)
ddx.vs: Exogenous material is typically localized to a prior procedure track and lacks the multifocal rosette-shaped birefringent crystals of systemic oxalosis.
